findings.title: CT: brand-like names outside northwind-bakery.test
findings.why_it_matters: Certificates for hostnames containing your brand but not under your domain can indicate lookalike sites. Many hits are false positives — review carefully.

findings.title: Lookalike resolves: secure-northwind-bakery.test
findings.why_it_matters: A publicly resolving lookalike can be used for phishing, brand impersonation, or confusion. Investigate ownership and certificate use.

findings.why_it_matters: Wildcards and login/admin-style names in CT can expand your attack surface inventory.
